name: DHL Supply Chain - Diageo Campus - Plainfield/Bolingbrook IL

fieldNotes.truckGate: Chain-link cantilever sliding gate across the truck driveway at the NW corner of the property (confirmed in Street View 2019-07). Property fully fenced with chain-link.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible at the gate. A driver-instruction sign reads 'Form single line on right side of driveway / Wait in truck until you reach front of line / Pull up to fence to check in' — indicating remote/kiosk check-in, not a manned booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Truck gate present, no guard shack; driver sign directs trucks to 'pull up to fence to check in' = remote check-in.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Cross-dock building with dock doors on BOTH long faces; many trailers backed in on each side. Estimated ~90 doors total from z18-z20 imagery; band 50+ is confident, exact count approximate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Long rows of unhitched trailers parked on the west truck lane between this building and the adjacent property; clearly 50+.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock doors on two opposite long faces of the building support separate ship/receive flows.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Driver sign instructs trucks to queue single-file in the driveway outside the gate.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Wide internal truck lanes and a long approach can hold a 3+ truck queue.
